confidence.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
confidence.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_event_with_context, get_related_filings · Private data: get_event_with_context, whats_new, scan_recent_events, list_company_filings, get_filing_parsed, list_coverage · Public sink: get_entity_state · Destructive: get_event_with_context, get_filing_parsed.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_event_with_context, get_related_filings · Private data: get_event_with_context, whats_new, scan_recent_events, list_company_filings, get_filing_parsed, list_coverage · Public sink: get_entity_state · Destructive: get_event_with_context, get_filing_parsed

confidence.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
